features.description: UMP consent before any ad or analytics call
features.acceptance: On first launch the Google UMP form (AdsConsent) is requested and shown where required before any ad request and before analytics starts; consent state is persisted and re-read on launch; Settings has a PRIVACY entry that reopens the privacy options form whenever `privacyOptionsRequirementStatus` is REQUIRED; the UMP form is Google's own and is not restyled or covered; unit tests cover the gate (no ad or analytics call reaches the backend before consent resolves, in every consent status); web stub takes `?consent=required|obtained|notRequired` for L2

`src/engine/adCadence.ts`: pure, seed-free state machine over events (appLaunch, sessionStart, scanComplete, resultShown, returnToViewfinder, rewardedShown, interstitialShown, tick(ms)) that answers `shouldPreload` and `shouldShow`; invariants: never in the first session of an install, never at launch or exit, never on the reveal, show only on returnToViewfinder, at most one per 2 completed scans, at most one per 180 s, never within 60 s after a rewarded ad, preload at least one event ahead of a permitted show; property tests over 10,000 random event sequences assert every invariant; README in src/engine documents the machine

The result screen's partially decoded signature leads into one DEEP SCAN key that states a sponsored segment plays (in the instrument voice, no banned words, no trick wording); the rewarded ad (test unit ID) runs only on that tap; on reward the full entity profile, the high-resolution apparition and the EVP line unlock for that scan and persist in the scan record; on dismiss without reward nothing changes and no second prompt appears in that session; load and failure states are in character and never pose as system alerts; web stub takes `?reward=1|0` for L2; goldens for locked and unlocked result at 390; unit tests cover unlock persistence

features.description: Interstitial wired to the cadence machine
features.acceptance: The interstitial (test unit ID) is requested and shown only where `adCadence` permits, on the return from result to viewfinder; it is preloaded when the machine says so; no interstitial on launch, exit, reveal or in the first session; an L2 spec walks two scans in a first session and two in a second session and asserts the `__adsLog` sequence (no show in session 1, at most one show in session 2); the scan count and session index come from the existing session store

features.description: Banner on the history screen only
features.acceptance: One anchored adaptive banner (test unit ID) at the bottom of the history screen, at least 24 dp from any tappable control and never overlapping the list; no banner component on any other route (an L2 spec asserts the banner testID is absent on boot, viewfinder, scan, result and settings); the banner slot has a fixed height so the layout does not shift on load

features.description: Analytics facade that starts only after consent
features.acceptance: `src/analytics/` exposes `track(event, params)` with a short allowlist of events (consent_status, scan_complete{tier,intensity}, deep_scan_offered, deep_scan_rewarded, interstitial_shown, share_card); nothing is sent before consent resolves to obtained or notRequired; the Firebase backend (@react-native-firebase/app and analytics 26.x) is wired behind the presence of `google-services.json` and `analytics_auto_collection_enabled:false` in firebase.json, enabled only by the facade after consent; without the file the build uses the no-op backend; unit tests cover the gate
features.blocked_by: owner: Firebase project and google-services.json for the native backend; the facade and gate are built now

features.acceptance: Compliance reviews the P5 contract before build and the P5 diff before merge against plan §7 red lines, §8 ad rules and digest §4 (Play, AdMob, GDPR/TDDDG); returns PASS or VETO per feature with the rule and file:line; every VETO is fixed before merge; logged in docs/decisions.md

features.description: Privacy policy, Data safety map and Impressum draft
features.acceptance: `docs/privacy-policy.md` (EN; DE in P7) covering the Mobile Ads SDK, UMP, Firebase Analytics, on-device photo processing (not collected), local scan history; `docs/data-safety.md` mapping each shipped SDK to Play Data safety answers; `docs/impressum.md` with placeholders for the owner's trader address (DSA) and §5 DDG fields; a Settings entry LEGAL opens the policy in the system browser (URL placeholder until hosted); Compliance PASS
EAS e2e-android Maestro flow reaches the result, taps DEEP SCAN and the recording shows the Google test rewarded ad; blocked by expo.dev allowlist, EXPO_TOKEN and the AdMob app ID (owner)
features.blocked_by: owner: expo.dev allowlist, EXPO_TOKEN, AdMob account

features.acceptance: The Refuter (a model other than the builders') tries to disprove P5-01 to P5-09 from command outputs, screenshots and the diff; every HOLD is flipped by the Director; every DISPROVED is fixed and re-checked
